answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a lotus as the anchor of the cost.
